$comment: Single source of truth for routing and flags. Set enabled:false to take an app offline; its slug then serves the 'switched off' page instead of 404. Array order is the order on the landing page. Any user-facing string may be a plain string or an object keyed by language code.

tagline.en: Small self-contained things, made on a phone.
tagline.fr: De petites choses autonomes, faites au téléphone.
